import importlib.util
import json
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
SCRIPT_DIR = ROOT / "scripts"
sys.path.insert(0, str(SCRIPT_DIR))
SCRIPT_PATH = SCRIPT_DIR / "validate_seed_task_contracts.py"
SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("seed_task_contracts_browser", SCRIPT_PATH)
MODULE = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
assert SPEC and SPEC.loader
sys.modules[SPEC.name] = MODULE
SPEC.loader.exec_module(MODULE)


class BrowserRuntimeSeedTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.source = json.loads(
            (ROOT / "db" / "seeds" / "test" / "sources" / "engine-browser-runtime-fixtures.json").read_text(
                encoding="utf-8"
            )
        )
        self.workspaces = json.loads(
            (ROOT / "test" / "fixtures" / "browser-runtime-workspaces.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        )

    def test_four_reference_contracts_cover_js_and_ts_input_and_form(self):
        self.assertEqual(len(self.source["lessons"]), 4)
        expected = (
            ("js.ast", False, False),
            ("ts.ast", True, False),
            ("js.ast", False, True),
            ("ts.ast", True, True),
        )

        for lesson, (script_engine, has_build, has_network) in zip(self.source["lessons"], expected):
            task = lesson["tasks"][0]
            stages = task["code_structure"]["stages"]
            browser = stages[2]
            checks = browser["checks"]
            with self.subTest(title=task["en"]["title"]):
                self.assertEqual([stage["engine"] for stage in stages], ["html.dom", script_engine, "browser.runtime"])
                self.assertEqual([stage["mode"] for stage in stages], ["both", "both", "final"])
                self.assertEqual(set(browser["depends_on"]), {stages[0]["id"], stages[1]["id"]})
                self.assertEqual("build" in checks, has_build)
                self.assertEqual(bool(checks.get("networkMocks")), has_network)
                self.assertEqual(task["task_kind"], "frontend_preview")
                self.assertEqual(task["execution_mode"], "BROWSER_PREVIEW")
                self.assertEqual(task["ui_mode"], "PREVIEW")
                self.assertTrue(task["exposes_preview"])
                self.assertFalse(task["exposes_terminal"])
                self.assertTrue(task["supports_live_validation"])
                self.assertNotIn("volumes", lesson["compose_config"]["services"]["app"])

    def test_input_checks_cover_nonempty_and_empty_values(self):
        for lesson in self.source["lessons"][:2]:
            interactions = lesson["tasks"][0]["code_structure"]["stages"][2]["checks"]["interactions"]
            self.assertEqual([interaction["value"] for interaction in interactions], ["Ada", ""])
            self.assertEqual([interaction["expectValue"]["value"] for interaction in interactions], ["Ada", ""])
            self.assertEqual(
                [interaction["expectTextContains"]["value"] for interaction in interactions],
                ["Hello, Ada!", "Enter your name"],
            )

    def test_form_checks_are_offline_and_verify_pending_success_and_error(self):
        for lesson in self.source["lessons"][2:]:
            checks = lesson["tasks"][0]["code_structure"]["stages"][2]["checks"]
            mock = checks["networkMocks"][0]
            submissions = [item for item in checks["interactions"] if item["action"] == "submit"]
            self.assertEqual(mock["expectedRequests"], 2)
            self.assertEqual(len(mock["responses"]), 2)
            self.assertEqual(
                [[state["value"] for state in item["expectTextSequence"]] for item in submissions],
                [["Sending...", "Welcome, Ada!"], ["Sending...", "Email is already registered"]],
            )

    def test_starter_preserves_preview_structure_but_does_not_pass_behavior(self):
        for lesson in self.source["lessons"]:
            task = dict(lesson["tasks"][0])
            task["code"] = task["code_structure_type_code"]
            workspace = MODULE.build_workspace(task)
            self.assertIn('<script src="app.js" defer></script>', workspace["index.html"])
            self.assertIn("Add the browser event handler", next(value for key, value in workspace.items() if key != "index.html"))
            self.assertFalse(MODULE.validate_validation_contract(task, task["code_structure"], workspace))

    def test_typescript_preview_uses_pinned_node_builder(self):
        for lesson in (self.source["lessons"][1], self.source["lessons"][3]):
            services = lesson["compose_config"]["services"]
            self.assertIn("builder", services)
            self.assertIn("@sha256:", services["builder"]["image"])
            self.assertIn("stripTypeScriptTypes", services["builder"]["command"][-1])
            self.assertEqual(services["app"]["depends_on"], ["builder"])
            self.assertNotIn("volumes", services["app"])

    def test_reference_workspaces_cover_starter_solution_and_superficial_cases(self):
        for kind in ("input", "form"):
            fixture = self.workspaces[kind]
            self.assertIn("index.html", fixture)
            self.assertIn("event handler", fixture["starter"])
            for language in ("javascript", "typescript"):
                with self.subTest(kind=kind, language=language):
                    self.assertIn("addEventListener", fixture[language]["solution"])
                    self.assertIn("addEventListener", fixture[language]["superficial"])
                    if kind == "form":
                        self.assertIn("fetch", fixture[language]["solution"])
                        self.assertNotIn("fetch", fixture[language]["superficial"])
                    else:
                        self.assertIn("Enter your name", fixture[language]["solution"])
                        self.assertNotIn("Enter your name", fixture[language]["superficial"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
